decisions.reason: The hand-knotted wool silk carpet embodies the brand's craftsmanship and fine-materials positioning, and slack from a growing industry lets the firm carry a slow-selling premium piece.
After A was pruned, this decorative low-pile carpet still overlaps with E and remains a candidate for a later collection refresh, but there is no clear shortfall that forces withdrawal now.
The corner bench extends the established seating and dining offer for residential and hospitality projects, and nothing signals that it falls short of aspirations.
This low-pile carpet is a low-cost addition close to the core, and with A gone it carries less overlap, so satisficing favours keeping it.
The multi-model swivel shell chair line represents a substantial investment serving residential, workplace and public interiors, so it is very likely to stay.
